desc: Ideation: structural fact (K smallest tops vs K largest bottoms) and candidate approaches identified.
Write the complete Python solution: fast stdin reading, O(N) two-pointer greedy (tops from first half, bottoms from index N//2, match when 2*A[i] <= A[j], count matches), print the answer.
Validate mentally on samples (3, 0, 6) and edge cases: N=2, all-equal sizes → 0, doubling sequence → N//2, large N performance.
